commands.path: cancel run apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the cancel run reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dbt cancel run apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: cancels an in-progress dbt Cloud run; stops warehouse queries mid-execution, external mutation, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: create job apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the create job reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dbt create job apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new scheduled/triggerable dbt Cloud job definition; low-risk until triggered, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: create notification apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the create notification reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dbt create notification apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: registers an outbound job-status notification (email or Slack channel of the caller's choosing); low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.path: create ssh tunnel apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the create ssh tunnel reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dbt create ssh tunnel apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates an SSH tunnel encrypting traffic for a warehouse connection; may carry a private key in the request body, external mutation, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: delete job apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete job reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dbt delete job apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: irreversible removal of a job definition (its schedule/trigger and run history reference); approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: delete notification apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete notification reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dbt delete notification apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: removes an existing job-status notification configuration; approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: delete ssh tunnel apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete ssh tunnel reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dbt delete ssh tunnel apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: removes an SSH tunnel; the associated warehouse connection falls back to unencrypted/direct connectivity, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: retry failed job apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the retry failed job reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dbt retry failed job apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: retries a job's most recent failed run from the point of failure; runs real warehouse queries, external mutation with warehouse side effects, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: retry run apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the retry run reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dbt retry run apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: retries a specific failed run from the point of failure; runs real warehouse queries, external mutation with warehouse side effects, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: runs list
examples: pm dbt runs list --json

commands.path: ssh tunnels list
commands.summary: Run the ssh tunnels ETL stream
examples: pm dbt ssh tunnels list --json

commands.path: trigger job run apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the trigger job run reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dbt trigger job run apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: kicks off a real dbt Cloud job run against the configured warehouse connection (builds/materializes models, can run arbitrary project SQL); external mutation with warehouse side effects, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: update job apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the update job reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dbt update job apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates an existing dbt Cloud job's definition (steps, schedule, environment); a changed schema/target affects the next triggered run, external mutation, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: update notification apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the update notification reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dbt update notification apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: repoints or reconfigures an existing job-status notification's destination (email/Slack channel); external mutation, approval required for a changed destination
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: update ssh tunnel apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the update ssh tunnel reverse-ETL action
examples: pm dbt update ssh tunnel apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates an existing SSH tunnel's connection details; may carry a private key in the request body, external mutation, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
